text.tspan: Human repetition carries what phones do not recover.
Receives a nine-winter-old sentence and its
Says them to the water, one a day.
Cameras file her leaving as weather.
A > B: returns remembered speech / A > C: remembered by mouth / C > D: sayings travel / A > E: asks her to learn / A > F: filed in another category
The price the cat paid for words is withheld. Her departure does not certify the identity of another hill cat.
